text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to scrub resources and finalize launch criteria for Project Helios. Product is aiming for canary by May 15 and a customer pilot on May 22. Can eng/runtime/infra/security confirm blockers?

jonathan: runtime: prewarm plan needed for sustained 1k qps. We can do warm pools + burst nodes but need infra signoff. ETA ~2w if nothing else blocks.

sam: infra: capacity looks doable but staging needs the kernel patch (linux-5.15.x) before prewarm test. Patch window will cause rolling restarts. Also security needs HSM/KMS for pilot.

eli: runtime note: model v1 quantized to 8-bit looks ~12% cheaper and perf is fine, but eval shows a ~1.8% quality dip on our summarization prompts. Propose A/B in canary with fallback to full-precision.

lia: product: A/B + fallback ok if we keep strict SLA on latency (p95 < 350ms) and have automated rollback if quality regresses > 2%. We also need a prioritized prompt set for eval.

jonathan: agree — I'll own routing + fallback policies. Need product to lock eval prompts list and acceptance thresholds.

maya: prompt set uploaded: https://redwood.internal/drive/helios-prompts (please use internal only).

nora: eng-security: KMS/HSM access can be provisioned for the pilot but we need audit hooks and rotation policy in place. I'll deliver the audit hook work in ~3 days. Whitelist requested.

sam: kernel patch scheduled for 6201234600. We'll do rolling restarts in the maintenance window — expect brief 3-5m blips per shard. Recommend canary after patch completes.

maya: canary window proposal: 24h, 20% traffic. Acceptance: p95 < 350ms, error rate stable, quality regression <= 2%. If regression > 2% auto-revert.

eli: we'll stream eval metrics to the dashboard and create a regression alert. Note: if fallback triggers frequently cost might exceed baseline — estimate +8-15% in that worst case.

lia: product ok to reserve contingency budget for fallback. Need clear rollback owner and runbook.

jonathan: owners: routing/fallback = jonathan; prewarm/runtime tuning = eli; infra patch & capacity = sam; KMS/audit = nora; acceptance/prompts = lia/maya. I'll draft a short runbook and share.

maya: please add your acceptance bullets to the Confluence page by EOD. If anyone can't meet that, ping me tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

sam: will add infra rollout steps.

eli: adding eval metrics + A/B config.

nora: audit hooks scheduled and I'll publish the whitelist list.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: helios-v1-prewarm to staging at 6201234700 by jonathan.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 6201234720 — helios-v1-canary (20% traffic) :rocket:

lia: monitoring initial telemetry — p95 ~320ms, error rate normal so far.

maya: nice. closing loop for now — follow-up 10AM tomorrow to confirm canary health and readiness for pilot. Thanks everyone.
